clue.text: Good walk may be a chancy thing

parts.note: an amble is a leisurely walk

explanation.surface: A pleasant stroll is described as possibly a risky venture.
explanation.definitionFit: A gamble is a risky undertaking whose outcome depends on chance.

clue.text: Place with lots of goings-on — you, we hear, joined in

indicators.note: joined in says the sounded letter goes into the middle of the other piece

parts.note: goings-on are happenings or action

indicators.note: we hear tells us to take the spoken sound of the word you

parts.note: the word you, spoken, is the letter U

explanation.surface: A place full of activity, which you have joined.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Lots' looks like 'plenty', but here it means items for sale, numbered lots at a sale room.
explanation.definitionFit: A sale room where numbered lots are sold to the highest bidder is exactly such a place.

clue.text: Bishop meets model — a very pleasurable experience

parts.note: B is the chess abbreviation for bishop
a last is a shoemaker's model of a foot

explanation.surface: A clergyman meeting a fashion model has a wonderful time.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Model' suggests a catwalk; here it is the cobbler's foot-shaped form.
explanation.definitionFit: Informally a blast is a thoroughly enjoyable time, as in 'the party was a blast'.

clue.text: Fired up, seeing red, going crazy

indicators.note: going crazy signals that the letters of seeing red are thrown into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone furious and losing control is all worked up.
explanation.definitionFit: Being fired up means being full of vigour and enthusiasm, invigorated.

clue.text: Troubled city sure gets protection

indicators.note: troubled signals that the letters of city sure are disturbed into a new order

explanation.surface: A troubled city is assured of safeguarding measures.
explanation.definitionFit: Security means safety measures or defence against danger, a synonym of protection.

clue.text: Speak with difficulty, say, when following holy person

indicators.note: when following places the word for say after the saint

parts.note: ST is the abbreviation for saint, a holy person
to utter something is to say it

explanation.surface: Someone trailing a saint struggles to get the words out.
explanation.definitionFit: To stutter is to speak haltingly, repeating initial sounds involuntarily.

clue.text: Eccentric characters offering greetings by post?

definitions.meaning: a card is informal for an amusingly odd person
birthday or Christmas greetings are sent as printed ... in the mail

explanation.surface: Oddballs send their regards through the mail.
explanation.definitionFit: Cards are both quirky individuals and folded greeting messages sent by mail.

clue.text: Discovering almost all the region, I celebrate

indicators.note: almost all says the final letter of the region word is dropped

parts.note: a realm is a kingdom or region
to sing is to celebrate in song

explanation.surface: Someone finds most of the area and joyfully marks the occasion.
explanation.definitionFit: Realising can mean becoming aware of, coming to discover a fact.

clue.text: On perch spot larva

indicators.note: in a down entry, on puts the first piece above the second

parts.note: a tad is a small amount, a spot
a perch is an old unit of length equal to a pole

explanation.surface: A bird watcher notices a grub sitting on a perch.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Perch' suggests a bird's resting place; it is the old measure of length, also called a rod or pole.
explanation.definitionFit: A tadpole is the aquatic larval stage of a frog or toad.

clue.text: Diana, a butcher, chopped up piece of beef

indicators.note: chopped up signals the letters of the butcher phrase are cut up and rearranged

explanation.surface: Diana, a butcher, minces a joint of meat.
explanation.definitionFit: A Chateaubriand is a thick cut from the tenderloin, a classic steak.

clue.text: Model getting drunk to refrain from participating

parts.note: to sit is to pose as a model for an artist
tight is informal for drunk

explanation.surface: A model gets drunk and so stays out of things.
explanation.definitionFit: To stay put and wait, taking no action, is the idiom's sense of holding back.

clue.text: Who may want lover? Men going to clubs?

indicators.note: going to puts the men after the clubs piece

parts.note: clubs is one of the four card suits
OR, other ranks, means soldiers who are not officers

explanation.surface: Men heading for nightclubs, perhaps hoping to find romance.
explanation.definitionFit: A wooer courting someone hopes to win them as a partner or spouse.

clue.text: Add this to make a foot visible!

definitions.text: Add this to make a foot visible!

parts.words: Add this to make a foot visible!
parts.note: twelve of these units of length add up to a foot; a hem raised by a few of them shows a foot

explanation.walkthrough: The foot is both a body part a long skirt hides and a unit of length built from twelve smaller units.
explanation.definitionFit: Twelve of these small imperial units of length make up one foot.

clue.text: The man needing to change — hospital one enters, becoming this?

definitions.text: The man needing to change — hospital one enters, becoming this?

parts.note: he is the pronoun for a man

indicators.note: enters says the hospital and one letters go inside the change word

parts.note: to alter is to change
H is the abbreviation for hospital, as on road signs
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A man who needs to change goes into hospital and comes out in better shape.
explanation.definitionFit: A patient admitted to hospital hopes to leave in better physical condition than before.

clue.text: Lying back in sports field marked out for game?

parts.note: rec is short for recreation ground, a public playing field
a pitch is lined, marked with white lines, before a match

explanation.surface: Relaxing on a playing field that has been prepared for a match.
explanation.definitionFit: To have leaned back into a resting position is to have lain back.

clue.text: Gossiped as mad person in church before start of devotions

indicators.note: before places the church piece ahead of the devotions letter
in puts the mad person inside the church letters

parts.note: CE is the Church of England
the Mad Hatter of Alice in Wonderland gives 'mad as a hatter'

indicators.note: start of takes just the opening letter of devotions

explanation.surface: A lunatic in church before prayers begin was talking idly.
explanation.definitionFit: To have chattered is to have talked idly and at length, as gossips do.

clue.text: Firm with locations in Germany producing kitchen item

parts.note: CO is the abbreviation for company, a firm
the Länder are the federal states of Germany

explanation.surface: A company with German branches makes kitchenware.
explanation.definitionFit: A colander is a perforated bowl used in the kitchen for draining food.

clue.text: US city established in moorland originally

indicators.note: established in says the letters are found sitting within the phrase moorland originally

explanation.surface: An American city first founded on moorland.
explanation.definitionFit: Orlando is a city in central Florida, famous for its theme parks.

clue.text: Are wayward boys to be found in grounds?

indicators.note: wayward signals the letters of are stray from their order

parts.note: sons are male children, boys

explanation.surface: Asks whether misbehaving boys can be found on the premises.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Grounds' looks like land around a building; here it means justifications.
explanation.definitionFit: Grounds for an action are the reasons or justification behind it.

clue.text: A university facing outburst when undergraduates are down?

indicators.note: facing puts the university letters in front of the outburst

parts.note: a gust is a sudden outburst, of wind or feeling

explanation.surface: A university confronts a burst of anger while students are away.
explanation.walkthrough: To 'go down' from university is to leave at the end of term, so students are away in the summer vacation.
explanation.definitionFit: This summer month falls in the long vacation, when students have gone home.

clue.text: Wrap up little son before toddle

indicators.note: before places the son letter ahead of the walking word

parts.note: S is the short form, the abbreviation, for son
to waddle is to walk with short swaying steps like a toddler

explanation.surface: Bundle up a small boy before he totters off.
explanation.definitionFit: To swaddle a baby is to wrap it tightly in cloth.

clue.text: Fate of idiot — how interminable!

parts.note: clot is British slang for a fool

indicators.note: interminable, without an end, says the last letter of how is cut off

explanation.surface: Lamenting the endless destiny of a fool.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek myth Clotho is one of the three Fates, the one who spins the thread of life.

clue.text: Ornamentalist's first job — getting rid of old colour

indicators.note: getting rid of, with old, says that letter leaves its place in the job word, so it can stand at the front instead

parts.note: a chore is a routine task, a job

indicators.note: first takes just the opening letter of the decorator word, which also leads the result

explanation.surface: A decorator's first task is to strip off an old paint colour.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Getting rid of' drops the O (old) from CHORE, leaving CHRE; 'Ornamentalist's first' supplies an O placed in front, so the O in effect moves to the start.
explanation.definitionFit: Ochre is an earthy yellow-brown pigment and the shade named after it.

clue.text: Despot in car, more or less despicable type

parts.note: auto is short for automobile, a car
C is circa, about, more or less
a rat is a contemptible person

explanation.surface: A tyrant sitting in a car is, roughly speaking, a nasty piece of work.
explanation.definitionFit: An autocrat is a ruler with absolute power, a tyrant.

clue.text: Boast when finally getting top award?

parts.note: to crow is to boast

indicators.note: finally takes just the closing letter of when

explanation.surface: Bragging upon finally winning the top prize.
explanation.definitionFit: A crown is awarded to a champion, the highest prize or title in a contest.

clue.text: Rough hobo, I end wandering around a particular area

indicators.note: wandering signals the letters of rough hobo, I end roam into a new order

explanation.surface: A tramp says he will finish up roaming about a certain district.
explanation.definitionFit: A neighbourhood is a district or locality within a town.

clue.text: Limits reported for those getting on plane?

indicators.note: reported tells us to take the spoken sound of the limits word

parts.note: borders are the limits or edges of an area

explanation.surface: Restrictions announced for airline passengers.
explanation.definitionFit: People who board an aircraft are those getting on it, passengers boarding.

clue.text: Insecurity giving daughter temper?

parts.note: temper means anger, as in losing one's temper

explanation.surface: A girl's tantrum causes feelings of unease.
explanation.definitionFit: Danger is a state of being exposed to harm, lacking safety.
